description: This file defines the AtMentionProvider class for handling '@' mention suggestions in a chat application, including local and server-fetched user, group, and special mention results, with support for filtering, sorting, and rendering suggestion groups.

classes.name: AtMentionProvider
classes.description: A provider class that offers '@' mention suggestions, combining local store data with server results, supporting filtering, sorting, and rendering of user, group, agent, and special mention suggestions.

methods.name: membersGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for channel members.

methods.name: defaultAgentGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for the default agent.

methods.name: agentsGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for agents.

methods.name: groupsGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for group mentions.

methods.name: specialMentionsGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for special mentions like @here, @channel, @all.

methods.name: nonMembersGroup
methods.description: Creates a suggestion group for users not in the channel.

methods.name: otherMembersGroup
methods.description: Creates a loading indicator group for other members.
